title: FatSecret and FitBit partnerships!
metaDescription: We are excited to announce that we are developing partnerships with FitBit and FatSecret that will enable patients to use these apps on their smartphones and have the data automatically sync with our patient support center!

author: DrCurry
bodyHtml: We are excited to announce that we are developing partnerships with FitBit and FatSecret that will enable patients to use these apps on their smartphones and have the data automatically sync with our patient support center!  We should have this live in the next couple of weeks, so stay tuned.  In the meantime go ahead and take a look at both apps so you can become familiar with how they work. Happy Losing, Dr. Trace Curry
